messages:
oliver: Quick heads-up: on 2026-04-12 02:00 UTC we'll consolidate three Jira projects (PROD-ENG, PLATFORM, INFRA) into a single project `PLATFORM`. This includes project key changes, board remapping, and SCIM group sync updates. Expected brief disruption to issue creation and webhook deliveries (~5-10m).

maria: TL;DR: project keys PROD-ENG -> PLATFORM, PLATFORM -> PLATFORM (merge), INFRA -> PLATFORM-INF. We'll run a dry-run on our staging tenant at 01:00 UTC.

product: any impact to customer-facing links or automations?

oliver: Short answers: 1) issue permalinks using keys will change; redirects will be in place for 30 days but update docs. 2) automations using project key conditions must be updated (scripts or chatops). 3) webhooks will briefly fail during the cutover window and auto-replay is enabled.

idp-bot: Note: SSO session cookies will be rotated during the cutover to add a new claim `project_access` for SCIM group sync compatibility. Users may need to re-login once.

maria: Action items for teams: - scan repos and integrations for old keys (`PROD-ENG`, `INFRA`) - update any JIRA API calls that use the project key instead of project ID - update dashboards and saved filters. See checklist: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PLAT-9001

platform-eng: Command to find references:
```bash
grep -R "PROD-ENG\|INFRA" || true
```

hr: Will this affect onboarding templates linked to old projects?

maria: Yes — onboarding template issues will be re-pointed to the new `PLATFORM` project. We'll keep copied templates in a read-only archive.

oliver: Rollback plan: snapshot database + revert mappings and SCIM sync config within 30m. We will rollback if >7% webhook failures or >200 migrated issues with missing fields.

product: Any manual updates required for Zapier/ops integrations?

maria: If you use third-party automations referencing project keys, please update them before cutover or they will fail. We will run a test suite during dry-run and post a list of failing integrations.

idp-bot: Dry-run started in staging at 01:00:12 UTC.

idp-bot: Live cutover started at 02:00:05 UTC. Applying project merges and SCIM sync changes.

idp-bot: Live cutover completed at 02:06:18 UTC. Redirects created; SCIM group mappings updated. Session cookie rotated.

oliver: Looks good from platform side. If you see missing watchers or permission gaps, drop the issue key + screenshot here.

platform-eng: Scanned common integrations, updated 8 workflows. No critical failures observed.

product: Spot-checked a few customer links; redirects working.

hr: Onboarding templates verified.

maria: Closing thread; final report attached to PLAT-9001 and we will keep redirects for 30 days. Please raise any follow-ups in the ticket.
